audience: international students working part-time in Japan
capabilities: Track shifts in month and week views with one colour per store
Compute pay by time band, overtime, holiday bonus and confirmed breaks
Warn when any 7-day window goes over 28 hours
Sync shifts to macOS Calendar or export .ics
Read rosters from selected text or photos with an AI service
disambiguation: Not a general note assistant; it tracks part-time shifts, pay and Japan's 28-hour student work limit.
extras: Free and MIT licensed, desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.13 or later; the interface is Chinese when Obsidian is set to Chinese and English otherwise; calendar sync works only with the macOS Calendar app, while .ics export works anywhere; AI roster reading is optional and billed by the chosen provider.
problem: Japanese part-time pay depends on time bands, overtime, holiday bonuses and breaks, and student work permission caps hours at 28 per 7 days, which is hard to track by hand.

relations.evidence: Sync to macOS Calendar from the ⋯ menu: smart sync writes only changed shifts

summary: Shift tracker for part-time work in Japan that works out pay by time band and store, warns on the 28-hour student limit, and syncs to macOS Calendar.
